chunks: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: Indeed, Allah Mighty and Majestic does not answer a supplication manifested by an inattentive heart. So whenever you supplicate, be attentive with your heart, then be convinced of the answer.

key_terms.الإجابة: The divine response or acceptance of supplication
key_terms.بِظَهْرِ قَلْبٍ: Literally 'from the back of the heart', meaning a supplication not rooted in true inner attention
key_terms.قَلْب سَاهٍ: An inattentive, heedless, or distracted heart — one not fully present during supplication

ai.seo_question: Why does Allah not answer prayers made with an inattentive heart?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) teaches that God does not accept prayers made by a distracted or heedless heart. The believer must bring full presence of heart to supplication and hold firm certainty that their prayer will be answered. This teaching reflects the Shia emphasis on the inner spiritual dimension of worship — that outward form without inner sincerity is insufficient.
